continuityLimitation: Full003 contains endpoint views only. Continuity score2 denotes plausible material/identity relationship across successive endpoint forms; it is not evidence of continuous tween animation, attachment continuity during motion, or correct gait.

clearEvolution.condition: Secondary agent distinctiveness>=2 across the predeclared endpoint subset
